source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
	ACID
	,RENEWAL_OPTION
	,RENEWAL_AMOUNT
	,RENEWAL_CRNCY
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_CRNCY
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_SRC
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RENEWAL_BOD, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RENEWAL_BOD
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE_CODE
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,TS_CNT
	,RENEWAL_MASTER_ACCT_ID
	,BANK_ID
	,AUTO_REN_POOL_CODE
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT2
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE_CODE2
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE2
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_FWC_NUM
	,RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_FWC_SOL_ID
	,RENEWAL_FWC_NUM
	,RENEWAL_FWC_SOL_ID
	,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM D360.STG_DEP_RENEWALOPTIONTABLE
